standard_prerequisites.name: Dimension is unchanged by etale extensions, and the strict henselization is a directed colimit of localisations of etale algebras

core_obligations: Use faithful flatness of the map to the strict henselization and going down to get the inequality between the dimensions (proof lines 11136-11140).
Write the strict henselization as a directed colimit of local rings each a localisation of an etale algebra over the base (proof lines 11140-11144).

Show that a finite chain of primes in the colimit comes from a chain in some stage, so that the dimension of the colimit is bounded by the supremum of the dimensions of the stages (proof lines 11144-11152).
Apply the invariance of dimension under etale extensions to conclude equality (proof lines 11152-11156).
proof_roadmap: First inequality by going down (proof lines 11136-11140).
Express the strict henselization as a colimit (proof lines 11140-11144).
Pull chains of primes back to a stage (proof lines 11144-11152).
Use the etale case and conclude (proof lines 11152-11157).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a local ring and its henselization and strict henselization have the same dimension, and the proof is a 22-line argument that separates the two inequalities. The inequality in one direction comes from going down along the faithfully flat map to the strict henselization; the other direction uses the description of the strict henselization as a directed colimit of rings each of which is a localisation of an etale algebra over the base, shows that any finite chain of primes in the colimit is the image of a chain in some stage, and then applies the equality of dimensions for etale extensions. The colimit argument is the substance, and it is displayed.
